summary: Northern Samar 1st District representative with 174 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps targeting with nutrition grants, an autism-care framework, cheaper internet, child support enforcement, social-media safeguards for minors, dual-citizen candidacy and a bill postponing the November 2026 barangay and SK elections; co-authored front-of-package warnings and telecom refunds.
caveat: Single-issue bills in social, civil-liberties and election areas left unscored. Economic score is bill-based only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps nutrition-grant targeting (-3) and a national autism-care framework (-2); cheaper internet access and co-authored telecom refunds and food warning labels (-1 to -2, consumer regulation). No tax-side or privatization evidence.
